# 8Aviation

> 8Aviation is a private jet charter company based at London Biggin Hill Airport, also
> flying from Farnborough, Luton and Stansted. It offers a diverse fleet — from turboprops
> and light jets to a specialism in ultra-heavy, ultra-long-range aircraft — with 20 years'
> experience, a 24-hour operations team, and door-to-door chauffeur service across Europe
> and the USA. 8Aviation flies operated, managed and carefully brokered aircraft.

Key facts:
- Company: 8Aviation
- Service: private jet charter (private jet hire)
- Home base: London Biggin Hill Airport (BQH)
- Also serves: Farnborough (FAB), London Luton (LTN), London Stansted (STN), and airports UK-wide, Europe and the USA
- Specialism: ultra-long-range jets — Gulfstream G650, Bombardier Global 7500, Global 6000, Global Express XRS
- Operations: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Experience: 20 years
- Website: https://charter-private-jet.com
- Enquiries: charter@charter-private-jet.com

## Fleet
- Ultra-long-range (specialism): Gulfstream G650, Global 7500, Global 6000, Global Express XRS — intercontinental, non-stop
- Midsize jets: Cessna Citation XLS+, Citation Sovereign+
- Light jets: Citation CJ1, Citation M2, Citation CJ2+, Embraer Phenom 300E
- Turboprops: Beechcraft King Air 250, Pilatus PC-12

## Common questions
- Private jet charter from Biggin Hill, Farnborough, Luton and Stansted
- Costs depend on aircraft, route, flight time and passengers — quotes are fixed and tailored
- Short-notice and same-day charter available, subject to availability, via the 24-hour operations desk
- Operated, managed and brokered aircraft from a trusted, long-standing group of operators
